name: Docker
description: Register the local Docker daemon and give agents scoped, human-approved access to containers through an mcp__cockpit-docker__* server. The plugin talks to the Docker Engine API itself (via Docker.DotNet) and keeps the connection — an agent never gets the Docker socket. Every call is gated: the first touch of the daemon asks for consent (reads are free after that), and every change (start/stop/remove/run) asks afresh with the literal command shown and is never remembered. Exec is off until you turn it on. A per-daemon consent mode (Always ask / Read-free / All-free) can pre-approve reads or everything, visibly, in the plugin settings. Configure the daemon endpoint in the plugin settings (blank uses the local default socket).
author: Cockpit
